title: Fate/stay night
source: Fate/stay night visual novel by Type-Moon (routes Fate, Unlimited Blade Works, Heaven's Feel), with Fate/Zero as background. Saber uses the Fate route ending.
world: In Fuyuki City, seven Masters summon seven Servants, heroic spirits of legend, to fight to the death in the Holy Grail War for a wish-granting Grail. Student Shirou Emiya accidentally summons Saber, King Arthur, in the Fifth Holy Grail War. The Archer of the previous war, Gilgamesh, remains in the world. Each route shows a different outcome for the same war. Epic battles mixed with questions about ideals and regret.
power_system: Masters use magic circuits and three Command Seals to give absolute orders to their Servant. Servants come in seven classes (Saber, Archer, Lancer, Rider, Caster, Assassin, Berserker) and fight with Noble Phantasms, legendary weapons or abilities. Servants need mana from their Master to stay in the world.
